title: Choose the Contract Gateway
description: The game contract lives on Soroban. A client has to simulate an invocation, assemble the resulting footprint and authorization entries, then submit the transaction for inclusion.

content.prompt: Which service does a client use to simulate, submit and read Soroban smart contract invocations?

hint: Horizon serves classic ledger and transaction data. Soroban RPC exposes `simulateTransaction`, `sendTransaction` and `getTransaction` for smart contract calls, which is what wallets and games use to prepare invocations. Documentation: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/build/smart-contracts/overview
author: StellarHunts Core
